title: Acquiring William Corliss's Sourcebook Project papers

tellings.quote:
Yeah, William Corless. He wrote this
series of books called source book
project.

plain: The UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels he got hold of the papers of William Corliss, an American who wrote a series of books called the Sourcebook Project, and brought them from the United States to Sweden. Svahn tells it as his own doing, part of how he built up one of the largest collections of UFO evidence anywhere.
